Original CARA P1 / PHPR. Periodic curve: 128 batches, stdout precision (3 decimals). Full6300 evaluations at steps 3000 and 8000 are separate summary evidence, not curve points. Exact final loss is recorded in the supplied export header. Resume duplicates agree. Topology changed: single GPU steps 1–3, two GPUs steps 4–174, single GPU steps 175–8000; no unified throughput claim. Curvature/HVP computation adds cost.

Original CARA-Muon, seed 0, matrix peak LR 0.0008, rate bounds [0.8, 1.25]. Curve uses fixed32 evaluations (524288 tokens); terminal fixed32 loss 3.027356095612049 is retained separately. Ranking uses the distinct full184 terminal loss 3.048516574113265 (3014656 tokens), never inserted into the periodic curve. Model family and budget match Current SlimPajama; detailed architecture and batch decomposition are not supplied in this reading log and are not inferred. Identical validation split with older curves is not established.

Muon hardware/layout changed during training; no same-hardware speedup claim.
